title: Dhammagiri Accounts
kicker: Dhammagiri Forest Hermitage · Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc. · Kholo, Queensland
cpiName: the Australian consumer price index (World Bank, yearly average; for a year to 30 June, the average of the two calendar years it spans)
costDefShort: the total expenses the charity reports to the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) each year, which can include wear on buildings (depreciation).
defs: Spending: the total expenses Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc. reports to the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC) in its yearly Annual Information Statement; the statement does not separate wear on buildings (depreciation) or the kinds of cost. Residents: the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas listed at Dhammagiri on the community lists, on average; guests and lay residents are not counted. Inflation: the Australian consumer price index (World Bank). All amounts in Australian dollars, as paid at the time, unless the page says "in today's money".
holdLede: The statement also gives what the charity owns and owes at the end of each year.
holdSub: Net assets: everything the charity owns less everything it owes, at the end of each year.
cardWhere: Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc. · Kholo, Queensland · amounts in Australian dollars
sources: Source anyone can check: Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc. (ABN 84 358 631 510): ABN Lookup and the ACNC Charity Register (search by ABN); the yearly figures are in the ACNC's published Annual Information Statement data. Residents: the monasteries' community lists. Updated __UPDATED__
meaningNote: The statements give totals only, so this page cannot say what the money was spent on.
holdNote: The charity reports no, or almost no, liabilities, so net assets are close to total assets.
notes: Where the figures come from. Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc. (Australian business number 84 358 631 510) is a registered charity. Its yearly totals come from the ACNC's published Annual Information Statement data for the years 2017 to 2024 (acnc_ais.csv in this folder keeps the rows for this charity).
Years. The charity's year is the calendar year, January to December. It is named by the year it ends in: "2024" is January to December 2024.

What the statement shows. Total income, total expenses, total assets and total liabilities. It has no cost lines and does not separate wear on buildings (depreciation), so nothing is taken out of spending and this page cannot show what the money went on.
Money in. Total gross income as reported. Some of it can be given for a set purpose, such as building work, which the statement does not show.
Which charity. Dhammagiri Forest Hermitage is run by Brisbane Buddhist Vihara (Temple) Inc.; the ACNC register lists the website dhammagiri.net for it.
Basic religious charity. From 2024 the charity is classed as a basic religious charity, which does not have to give the financial questions of the statement; it still reported its figures.
Not in the accounts. Food, and much of the work done for a monastery, is given by supporters and is not a cost line.
Residents are the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas on the community lists. Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
